author: Richard Amesbury

citation_system: section number and title of the entry (e.g. §2.2.4, Wittgenstein), as in the archived Spring 2026 edition
notes: Secondary witness for Wittgensteinian fideism (#1010): the four theses of the characterization, Nielsen's coinage (Philosophy 42, 1967), Phillips's rejoinder (1981, 89-90) and his later view, and Pritchard's quasi-fideism from On Certainty. Pinned as a web snapshot because the primary works (Nielsen 1967; Phillips 1976, 1981, 1995; Winch 1964; Nielsen and Phillips 2005) are in copyright with no legitimately hosted copy found. Claims attribute the positions the entry reports, not a view of the entry's author, and say so in their interpretation.
